description: This file defines data structures, validation functions, and macros related to the 'mort' table in the TrueTypeGX/AAT font specification, used within the FreeType font rendering library.

methods.name: gxv_mort_featurearray_validate
methods.description: Validates an array of 'mort' feature records within the font table.

methods.name: gxv_mort_coverage_validate
methods.description: Validates the coverage field of the 'mort' table.

methods.name: gxv_mort_subtable_type0_validate
methods.description: Validates a subtable of type 0 in the 'mort' table.

methods.name: gxv_mort_subtable_type1_validate
methods.description: Validates a subtable of type 1 in the 'mort' table.

methods.name: gxv_mort_subtable_type2_validate
methods.description: Validates a subtable of type 2 in the 'mort' table.

methods.name: gxv_mort_subtable_type4_validate
methods.description: Validates a subtable of type 4 in the 'mort' table.

methods.name: gxv_mort_subtable_type5_validate
methods.description: Validates a subtable of type 5 in the 'mort' table.
